title: 第025章 战力狂飙杀同阶如砍瓜切菜第026章 谁说他根骨差这特么是道士圆满的底子
slug: 九叔饲养百倍返还僵尸成旱魃
content_zh:
苏辰缓缓站起身，五指随意一握。
噼里啪啦——！
全身骨节发出一串脆响。
这次改变，不只是灵力暴涨。
他的筋骨、血肉，像被重新熔炼了一遍。
单凭肉身气血，就比突破前强出一大截！
哪怕不用道法增强实力，他一拳便能打死一头牛！
除此之外，他的经脉变得更宽，更坚韧！
调动灵力的速度，也比之前快了许多。
“铮——”
苏辰反手拔出黑煞骨剑。
剑身出鞘，寒煞扩散。
尸类栖地里刚聚拢来的阴雾，被剑锋划出一道裂痕。
他没有使用刚获得的新感悟，只凭原本大成境界的斩邪剑法出手。
脚下一踏。
腰马合一。
手腕翻转。
黑煞骨剑斜斩而出！
嗡——！
剑锋上，斩邪剑意亮起。

同样的剑招，同样的剑意。
这一次，灵力从丹田灌入剑身的速度，比之前快了太多。
心念刚动，剑气已到。
剑光贴着黑土掠过。
嗤啦——
轰！
前方阴雾被一剑切开，剑气余威不减，在黑土上犁出一道三尺多深、丈许长的剑痕。
苏辰眼神发亮。
换成突破前，他全力一剑也能斩开阴雾，却没有这种声势，更没有这种速度。
以前灵力从丹田调出，经过手臂，再传导到剑身，中间总会有一丝迟滞。
现在，那点迟滞没了。
真正的剑随念走。
念头一起，灵力已经充满剑锋。
他又斩出第二剑。
这一次，加重三分灵力。
轰！
剑光落下，尸类栖地的黑土震了一下，地面被划出一道细长剑痕，久久没有合拢。
苏辰看着剑痕，感受着体内奔涌不息的灵力，嘴角慢慢扬起。
“道士后期，直逼圆满。”
“灵力运转速度、肉身强度、爆发力，全都涨了一截。”

“若是现在再对上那个灰袍道人……”
苏辰冷笑。
“根本不用张星野牵制，也不用张清辞摇铃。单凭这柄剑，十数招之内，我就能正面卸了他的脑袋。”
他挽了个剑花，收剑入鞘。
content_en:
Su Chen slowly stood up and clasped his fingers casually.
Crackling——!
All the joints in his body made a series of crisp sounds.
This change is not just a surge in spiritual power.
His muscles, bones, flesh and blood seemed to have been re-melted.
The physical energy and blood alone are much stronger than before the breakthrough!
Even if he doesn't use Taoism to enhance his strength, he can kill a cow with one punch!
In addition, his meridians became wider and tougher!
The speed of mobilizing spiritual power is also much faster than before.
"Zheng——"
Su Chen pulled out the Black Evil Bone Sword with his backhand.
The sword was unsheathed, and the cold evil spread.
The dark fog that had just gathered in the corpse habitat was scratched by the sword's edge.
He did not use the new insights he had just gained, and only relied on the evil-killing sword skills of the original Dacheng realm.
A step under his feet.
The waist and horse are one.
Flip your wrist.
The black evil bone sword slashed out diagonally!
Buzz—!
On the edge of the sword, the evil-killing sword intent lights up.
The same sword moves, the same sword intention.
This time, the speed at which spiritual energy poured from the Dantian into the sword was much faster than before.
As soon as my mind moved, the sword energy had arrived.
The sword light passed against the black soil.
Tsk-
Boom!
The dark fog in front was cut open by a sword, and the sword energy remained powerful, plowing a sword mark more than three feet deep and ten feet long in the black soil.
Su Chen's eyes lit up.
Before the breakthrough, he could cut through the mist with one sword with all his strength, but he didn't have the momentum, let alone the speed.
In the past, when the spiritual power was transferred from the Dantian, passed through the arm, and then transmitted to the sword body, there would always be a slight lag in the middle.
Now, that lag is gone.
The real sword moves at will.
With the thought, spiritual power has filled the sword's edge.
He slashed out a second sword.
This time, add three points of spiritual power.
boom!
When the sword light fell, the black soil in the corpse habitat shook, and a long and thin sword mark was carved on the ground, which did not close for a long time.
Su Chen looked at the sword mark, feeling the spiritual power rushing through his body, and slowly raised the corners of his mouth.
"In the later stage of Taoism, one is approaching perfection."
"The speed of spiritual power, physical strength, and explosive power have all increased."
"If we face that gray-robed Taoist again now..."
Su Chen sneered.
"There is no need for Zhang Xingye to restrain him or Zhang Qingci to ring the bell. With this sword alone, within ten moves, I can remove his head head on."
He held a sword flower and put the sword into its sheath.
